chapter: Shows, scripts and the Mosby-era names
title: Spikes's wife Hallie and his son Robert
summary: He has been married twenty-five years to Hallie, whom he calls Preacher; his son Robert from his first marriage works nights at Alcoa.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: You were telling me that you've been married now for twenty-five years. What is her first name? So we get that on the tape.
No, her first name. Your wife.
Hallie. You call her 'Preacher.' Is that right?
Why, I...you know, when we met, she was teaching Bible Class at church, and I always called her 'Preacher' after that.
No. I've got a child but not by her. My first wife. My boy's fifty-five.
Robert. Does he live in Los Angeles?
Has he ever been involved in the music business?

No. He went to work for the Alcoa Aluminum when he was about sixteen or seventeen years old, and he's still there. He's been there about thirty...thirty-five...thirty-seven...thirty-eight years. He went to war, and when he come back, they gave him all that time, you know. And he be fifty-five next month, I think, and he's been there since he was about seventeen or eighteen years old. And he's always worked at night. He never would work in the day. He goes to work about eleven o'clock at night and gets off at seven in the morning. Only job he's ever had.
Gee. Unlike his father who has worked at a great many things.
Yeah, a hundred different places. Fired 'm all.
